allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Oberoi Realty Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on May 8, 2026-Board approves proposal for enabling raising of funds for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 4,000 Crore by way of issuance of non-convertible debentures by way of private placement

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Oberoi Realty Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on May 08, 2026 -Board approves proposal for enabling raising of funds for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 6,000 Crore by way of issuance of equity shares, eligible securities, other securities or instruments or any combination of securities, in one or more tranche or tranches, by way of private placement including a qualified institutions placement.
